statement: Return true if every pair of adjacent bits in the binary representation of a positive integer differs.

title: Binary Number with Alternating Bits
statement: Return true if every pair of adjacent bits in the binary representation of a positive integer differs.
code: class Solution { public boolean hasAlternatingBits(int n){int prev=n&1;n>>=1;while(n>0){int bit=n&1;if(bit==prev)return false;prev=bit;n>>=1;}return true;} }

title: Max Area of Island
statement: Given a binary grid, return the largest area of a connected island of 1s using four-directional adjacency.

title: Max Area of Island
statement: Given a binary grid, return the largest area of a connected island of 1s using four-directional adjacency.
code: class Solution { public int maxAreaOfIsland(int[][] grid){if(grid.length==0)return 0;int m=grid.length,n=grid[0].length,best=0;boolean[][]seen=new boolean[m][n];int[]dr={1,-1,0,0},dc={0,0,1,-1};for(int r=0;r<m;r++)for(int c=0;c<n;c++)if(grid[r][c]==1&&!seen[r][c]){ArrayDeque<int[]>st=new ArrayDeque<>();st.push(new int[]{r,c});seen[r][c]=true;int area=0;while(!st.isEmpty()){int[]v=st.pop();area++;for(int k=0;k<4;k++){int x=v[0]+dr[k],y=v[1]+dc[k];if(x>=0&&x<m&&y>=0&&y<n&&grid[x][y]==1&&!seen[x][y]){seen[x][y]=true;st.push(new int[]{x,y});}}}best=Math.max(best,area);}return best;} }

title: Count Binary Substrings
statement: Count non-empty substrings with equal numbers of consecutive 0s and 1s where all 0s and all 1s are grouped together.

title: Count Binary Substrings
statement: Count non-empty substrings with equal numbers of consecutive 0s and 1s where all 0s and all 1s are grouped together.
code: class Solution { public int countBinarySubstrings(String s){int prev=0,cur=1,ans=0;for(int i=1;i<s.length();i++){if(s.charAt(i)==s.charAt(i-1))cur++;else{ans+=Math.min(prev,cur);prev=cur;cur=1;}}return ans+Math.min(prev,cur);} }

title: Degree of an Array
statement: Return the minimum length of a contiguous subarray having the same degree as the whole array.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int findShortestSubArray(int[] nums){Map<Integer,Integer>count=new HashMap<>(),first=new HashMap<>(),last=new HashMap<>();for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){int x=nums[i];count.put(x,count.getOrDefault(x,0)+1);first.putIfAbsent(x,i);last.put(x,i);}int degree=Collections.max(count.values()),best=nums.length;for(int x:count.keySet())if(count.get(x)==degree)best=Math.min(best,last.get(x)-first.get(x)+1);return best;} }

title: Search in a Binary Search Tree
statement: Return the subtree rooted at the node whose value equals val, or null if no such node exists.
code: class Solution { public TreeNode searchBST(TreeNode root,int val){while(root!=null&&root.val!=val)root=val<root.val?root.left:root.right;return root;} }

title: Insert into a Binary Search Tree
statement: Insert val into a BST and return the root, preserving the BST property.
approach_name: Insert at the first null child
code: class Solution { public TreeNode insertIntoBST(TreeNode root,int val){if(root==null)return new TreeNode(val);if(val<root.val)root.left=insertIntoBST(root.left,val);else root.right=insertIntoBST(root.right,val);return root;} }

title: Binary Search
statement: Return the index of target in a sorted array, or -1 if absent.
code: class Solution { public int search(int[] nums,int target){int lo=0,hi=nums.length-1;while(lo<=hi){int mid=lo+(hi-lo)/2;if(nums[mid]==target)return mid;if(nums[mid]<target)lo=mid+1;else hi=mid-1;}return -1;} }

title: 1-bit and 2-bit Characters
statement: Given a bit array where 0 encodes one-bit character and 10 or 11 encodes two-bit character, return whether the last character is a one-bit character.
approach_name: Parse bits from left to right
code: class Solution { public boolean isOneBitCharacter(int[] bits){int i=0;while(i<bits.length-1)i+=bits[i]+1;return i==bits.length-1;} }

title: Find Pivot Index
statement: Return an index where the sum of elements to its left equals the sum of elements to its right, or -1 if none exists.
code: class Solution { public int pivotIndex(int[] nums){int total=0;for(int x:nums)total+=x;int left=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){if(left==total-left-nums[i])return i;left+=nums[i];}return -1;} }
